newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Carpenter says has share diminution deal.
newsitem.headline: Carpenter says has share diminution deal.

text.p: Carpenter Pacific Resources NL, the majority owner of the Mt Kare gold prospect in Papua New Guinea said that contrary to a report in The Australian newspaper any diminution of shareholdings would shared with joint venture partner Madison Enterprises Corp.

The company said it issued at statement in December last year that its subsidiary Matu Mining Pty Ltd and Madison had agreed to "share any diminution of Matu's interest on a pari passu (equal) basis proportional to our relative interests".
Matu holds the exploration licence at Mt Kare.
The newspaper said any reduction in shareholdings at Mt Kare, enforced by the PNG government, would be borne by Carpenter and its listed associate Ramsgate Resources NL.
